482: def _sbd_parse_watchdogs(watchdog_list):
483:     default_watchdog = None
484:     watchdog_dict = {}
485: 
486:     for watchdog_node in watchdog_list:
487:         if "@" not in watchdog_node:
488:             if default_watchdog:
489:                 raise CmdLineInputError("Multiple default watchdogs.")
490:             default_watchdog = watchdog_node
491:         else:
492:             watchdog, node_name = watchdog_node.rsplit("@", 1)
493:             if node_name in watchdog_dict:
494:                 raise CmdLineInputError(
495:                     "Multiple watchdog definitions for node '{node}'".format(
496:                         node=node_name
497:                     )
498:                 )
499:             watchdog_dict[node_name] = watchdog
500: 
501:     return default_watchdog, watchdog_dict
502:
